author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I just come across the most dangerous skill - home cleanup skill

This skill will look at your ~ directory and try to delete some useless stuff to reclaim some diskspace from your HOME path

I will never trust a robot barber cutting my hair with a sharp knife (power shaver is OK), I will never trust AI delete anything for me in my HOME.
